name: PM-KISAN
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India along with State/UT Nodal Departments
benefit_summary: Direct assured financial income support of Rs. 6,000 per year transferred directly into the bank accounts of landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 6,000 per financial year per eligible farmer family.
Disbursed in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months directly into the beneficiary's bank account.
Eliminates middlemen through 100% Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) linked with PFMS.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names in land records.

Exclusion criteria apply: Institutional landholders, farmer families holding constitutional posts, present/former Ministers/MPs/MLAs, serving/retired government officers, and pensioners receiving Rs. 10,000+ monthly pension.
required_documents: Land holding ownership documents / Record of Rights (RoR)
Bank Account details with IFSC Code
application_process: Visit the official PM-KISAN web portal at pmkisan.gov.in or download the PM-KISAN GoI mobile app.
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under the 'Farmers Corner' section.
Select Rural or Urban Farmer Registration, enter mobile number, select the State, and complete OTP authentication.
Fill in personal details, district, sub-district, block, and village.
Enter land survey numbers, khata numbers, and area in hectares, upload the land ownership document (RoR), and submit for State verification.
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and all landholding farmer families across India
funding_pattern: 100% funded by the Government of India

name: PMFBY
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: Empanelled General Insurance Companies / Agriculture Insurance Company of India (AIC)
benefit_summary: Comprehensive insurance cover against crop failure due to non-preventable natural risks, pests, and diseases from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages at highly subsidized premium rates.
benefits: Maximum premium payable by farmers is capped at 2% for Kharif food/oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food/oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.
Actuarial premium difference is funded as subsidy by Central and State Governments without upper capping.
Provides full sum insured coverage without claim amount reduction.
Covers prevented sowing, standing crop loss, localized calamities (hailstorm, landslide, inundation), and post-harvest losses up to 14 days.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
Voluntary enrollment for all farmers (loanee and non-loanee).
Must possess insurable interest in the notified crop cultivated.
required_documents: Bank Account Passbook copy showing IFSC code and account number
Land records (RoR / Land Possession Certificate / Khasra / Khatauni copy)
Sowing certificate or self-declaration of crop sown
application_process: Visit pmfby.gov.in or approach nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or bank branch.
Click on 'Farmer Corner' and select 'Enroll Now'.
Enter personal identification details, address, bank account details, and land parcel survey numbers.
Select notified crop and upload land ownership records and sowing declarations.
Pay the farmer's share of premium and obtain the application acknowledgment receipt.
target_beneficiaries: All landholding farmers, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers growing notified crops
funding_pattern: 50:50 premium subsidy between Centre and States (90:10 for North Eastern States)

name: KCC
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks, and Cooperative Banks
benefit_summary: Provides farmers with timely institutional credit under a single window for cultivation expenses, post-harvest costs, and working capital for allied activities.
benefits: Short-term crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakh at a concessional interest rate of 7% per annum.
Additional Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) of 3% per annum, bringing effective interest rate down to 4%.
Collateral-free agricultural credit limit up to Rs. 1.60 lakh (extendable up to Rs. 2 lakh).
Flexible withdrawal and repayment tied to harvest cycles.
eligibility: Individual farmers or joint borrowers who are owner-cultivators.
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers.
Farmers engaged in dairy, fisheries, poultry, and animal husbandry.
required_documents: Land ownership and revenue records (7/12 extract, Khasra, Khatauni)
application_process: Visit any Commercial Bank, RRB, or Cooperative Bank branch, or access Jan Samarth portal online.
Fill out the standardized KCC application form.
Attach identity proof, address proof, and land ownership records.
Submit the application to the bank branch manager.
Upon credit appraisal and land record verification, the KCC credit limit is sanctioned.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and livestock/fisheries farmers across India
funding_pattern: Interest subvention funded by Government of India through RBI and NABARD

name: PMKSY-PDMC
full_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Promotes micro-irrigation technologies (Drip and Sprinkler) to enhance on-farm water use efficiency and crop productivity.
benefits: Financial subsidy up to 55% of indicative unit cost for small and marginal farmers.
Subsidy up to 45% for other category farmers.
Reduces water consumption, power usage, weed growth, and fertilizer losses via fertigation.
eligibility: All landholding farmers, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers with valid lease agreements.
Farmers cultivating horticultural, commercial, or field crops.
required_documents: Bank Account Passbook copy showing IFSC code
Caste Certificate (for SC/ST category subsidy allocation)
application_process: Visit State-specific horticulture/agriculture micro-irrigation portal.
Register online with farmer details, land survey numbers, and target crops.
Select an empanelled micro-irrigation system manufacturer/supplier.
After field survey and technical approval, administrative sanction is issued.
Upon installation and joint physical verification, subsidy is transferred via DBT.
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and all agricultural farmers requiring micro-irrigation
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: Soil Health Card
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: State Agriculture Departments / Soil Testing Laboratories
benefit_summary: Issues comprehensive soil health reports with crop-wise nutrient management advice to optimize fertilizer usage.
benefits: Free scientific testing of farm soil samples across 12 key parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC).
Customized fertilizer dosage recommendations to prevent soil degradation and lower cultivation costs.
eligibility: All farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land across India.
application_process: Soil samples are collected from farmers' fields by department workers or KVK teams using GPS.
Samples are analyzed in static or mobile soil testing laboratories.
Results and customized crop recommendations are entered into soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
Printed Soil Health Cards are distributed directly to farmers.
target_beneficiaries: All agricultural farmers in India
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: PKVY
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: National Centre of Organic Farming (NCOF) / State Agriculture Departments
benefit_summary: Promotes chemical-free organic farming via cluster approach and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS-India) certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per hectare for 3 years (Rs. 31,000 directly via DBT for organic inputs).
Free organic certification under PGS-India.
Support for cluster formation, training, packaging, and marketing of organic produce.
eligibility: Farmers forming a group or cluster of 20 or more members covering 20-50 hectares.
required_documents: Bank Account details with IFSC code
application_process: Form a cluster of 20+ farmers and submit proposal to Block/District Agriculture Officer.
Department registers cluster on PGS-India portal (pgsindia-ncof.gov.in).
Undergo training and receive DBT installments for organic inputs over 3 years.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers adopting organic farming in clusters
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: SMAM
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Provides capital subsidies on agricultural machinery and supports creation of Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs).
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy for individual farmers purchasing tractors, tillers, harvesters, or drones.
Up to 80% subsidy for FPOs, cooperatives, and rural youth to establish Custom Hiring Centers.
eligibility: Individual landholding farmers, FPOs, PACS, and registered agricultural cooperatives.
required_documents: Bank Passbook copy with IFSC code
Approved machinery quotation from empanelled dealer
application_process: Register online at agrimachinery.nic.in.
Select desired farm machinery or CHC setup and upload quotation and land records.
Upon physical verification after purchase, subsidy is disbursed via DBT.
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and women farmers, FPOs, and agri-entrepreneurs
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: AIF
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: National Monitoring Committee / NABARD & Commercial Banks
benefit_summary: Debt financing facility providing interest subvention and credit guarantees for post-harvest management and community farming assets.
benefits: 3% interest subvention per annum on loans up to Rs. 2 crore for up to 7 years.
Credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE for loans up to Rs. 2 crore without external collateral.
Funding for godowns, cold chains, silos, assaying units, and solar farming assets.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Marketing Cooperatives, SHGs, Agri Startups, and Agri-entrepreneurs.
required_documents: Proof of land ownership or registered lease agreement
application_process: Apply online on agriinfra.dac.gov.in.
Complete registration, fill project details, upload DPR, and choose lending bank branch.
Bank evaluates application and sanctions loan with interest subvention tagging.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, SHGs, and Agri Startups across India
funding_pattern: 100% Central Sector Scheme funded by Government of India

name: NFSM
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: State Agriculture Departments / District Food Security Mission Committees
benefit_summary: Increases production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals, and nutri-cereals through high-yielding seed distribution and demonstrations.
benefits: Free or heavily subsidized high-yielding variety seed minikits.
Subsidies on soil ameliorants, bio-fertilizing agents, and plant protection chemicals.
Financial assistance for cluster field demonstrations and farm implements.
eligibility: All landholding farmers cultivating target food grain crops in notified districts.
application_process: Register via State Agriculture DBT portal or Block Agriculture Office.
Select notified crop seed minikit or demonstration assistance.
Distribution is carried out through state seed depots and Gram Panchayats.
target_beneficiaries: Food grain and pulse crop farmers across notified districts
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: NMSA
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Promotes climate-resilient agricultural practices, rainfed area development, integrated farming systems, and soil health management.
benefits: Financial subsidies for adopting Integrated Farming System (IFS) models.
Assistance for vermicompost units, green manuring, and water harvesting structures.
eligibility: All landholding farmers, with preference given to small/marginal farmers in rainfed regions.
application_process: Apply through Block Agriculture Officer or District NMSA Nodal Agency.
Customized farm integration plan is approved by departmental field teams.
target_beneficiaries: Rainfed and climate-vulnerable farmers across India
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: e-NAM
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking APMC mandis to build a unified market for agricultural commodities.
benefits: Transparent online price discovery and nationwide competitive bidding.
Real-time payment directly into farmer bank accounts via Direct Benefit Transfer.
Free scientific assaying and grading services at registered APMC mandis.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, traders, and commission agents operating in integrated mandis.
required_documents: Bank Passbook copy showing IFSC code
application_process: Register on enam.gov.in or e-NAM Mobile App as 'Farmer' or 'FPO'.
Select state and nearest e-NAM integrated APMC mandi.
Bring produce to mandi for digital lot entry, quality assaying, and online auction.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers, FPOs, and agricultural buyers across India
funding_pattern: 100% funded by Government of India for software and mandi integration

name: PM-KMY
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) / Common Service Centers (CSC)
benefit_summary: Voluntary social security pension scheme offering an assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 to small and marginal farmers upon reaching 60 years of age.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 after age 60.
50% matching monthly contribution by Government of India.
Spouse receives 50% family pension in the event of subscriber's death.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares aged 18 to 40 years.
application_process: Visit nearest CSC center or self-enroll at maandhan.in.
Submit land holding proof and bank account details.
Sign auto-debit mandate form for monthly contribution (Rs. 55 to Rs. 200 based on age).
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years
funding_pattern: 100% Central Sector Scheme with 50:50 matching monthly contribution

name: MIDH
full_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
implementing_agency: National Horticulture Board (NHB) / State Horticulture Missions
benefit_summary: Promotes holistic development of fruits, vegetables, mushrooms, spices, flowers, and aromatic plants.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy for high-density orchards, polyhouses, and pack houses.
Assistance for cold storage units, tissue culture units, and beekeeping.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, SHGs, and agricultural entrepreneurs possessing suitable land.
required_documents: Land records or registered lease deed
application_process: Apply online on State Horticulture Mission web portal or nhb.gov.in.
Upload DPR and land records for field appraisal and administrative approval.
target_beneficiaries: Horticulture growers and post-harvest infrastructure developers
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: RAD
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_summary: Focuses on Integrated Farming System (IFS) models integrating crops with livestock, horticulture, and fishery in rainfed districts.
benefits: Up to 50% financial subsidy for combining field cropping with livestock, poultry, or fishery.
Assistance for farm ponds and soil conservation assets.
eligibility: Landholding farmers in notified rainfed and drought-prone districts.
application_process: Apply through District Agriculture Officer in rainfed districts.
Customized IFS model plan is verified and approved on site.
target_beneficiaries: Rainfed agricultural farmers
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: PMMSY
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
implementing_agency: Department of Fisheries / State Fisheries Departments / NFDB
benefit_summary: Drives sustainable development of marine, inland, and aquaculture fisheries infrastructure.
benefits: 40% financial grant for General category and 60% for SC/ST and Women beneficiaries.
Support for fish ponds, biofloc units, RAS, hatcheries, and deep-sea vessels.
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, JLGs, FPOs, and fisheries cooperatives.
required_documents: Land records / registered lease deed for aquaculture
application_process: Submit application on state fisheries portal or NFDB website.
District Fisheries Officer conducts site inspection prior to approval.
target_beneficiaries: Fish farmers, traditional fishers, and aquaculture entrepreneurs
funding_pattern: 60:40 fund sharing between Centre and States (90:10 for NE/Himalayan States)

name: Rythu Bandhu
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
benefit_summary: Direct crop investment support of Rs. 10,000 per acre per year (Rs. 5,000 per season) transferred directly to landowning farmers.
benefits: Direct financial grant of Rs. 5,000 per acre per crop season for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, and farm inputs.
100% direct bank transfer without middleman intervention.
eligibility: Landowning resident farmers of Telangana with agricultural Pattadar Passbooks.
required_documents: Pattadar Passbook / Dharani land record details
application_process: Enrollment is automatic based on Dharani integrated land portal data.
New land buyers submit Pattadar details to local Agricultural Extension Officer (AEO).
target_beneficiaries: Landowning farmers in Telangana
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Telangana

name: KALIA
full_name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Empowerment, Government of Odisha
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Empowerment
implementing_agency: Directorate of Agriculture and Food Production, Odisha
benefit_summary: Direct financial assistance for small, marginal farmers, and landless agricultural households for cultivation and livelihood.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per family per year for small and marginal farmers.
Financial support of Rs. 12,500 for landless agricultural households for allied activities (goat rearing, duckery, fishery).
Annual grant of Rs. 10,000 for vulnerable agricultural households and landless laborers.
eligibility: Small, marginal farmers, landless agricultural households, and vulnerable farming families in Odisha.
application_process: Apply online on kalia.odisha.gov.in or complete Gram Panchayat inclusion forms.
Verification is conducted by District Level Nodal Officers.
target_beneficiaries: Small farmers, marginal farmers, landless agricultural laborers, and vulnerable families in Odisha
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Odisha

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefit_summary: Financial assistance of Rs. 13,500 per year provided to farmer families (including tenant farmers) in Andhra Pradesh.
benefits: Annual benefit of Rs. 13,500 per family disbursed in three seasonal installments.
Includes coverage for landless tenant farmers (CCRC holders) and ROFR tribal farmers.
eligibility: Farmer families owning land and tenant farmers possessing Crop Cultivator Rights Cards (CCRC) in AP.
application_process: Register through local Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBKs) / Village Agriculture Assistants.
Data is verified via state land registration systems.
target_beneficiaries: Landowning and tenant farmer families in Andhra Pradesh
funding_pattern: Combination of State budget top-up (Rs. 7,500) and Central PM-KISAN (Rs. 6,000)

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry & Cooperative, Government of Jharkhand
benefit_summary: Financial grant of Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 25,000 per year per farmer for purchasing seeds, fertilizers, and field inputs.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 5,000 per acre per year (up to maximum 5 acres / Rs. 25,000).
Disbursed in two equal seasonal installments prior to Kharif and Rabi sowing.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing in Jharkhand with agricultural land up to 5 acres.
application_process: Apply through District Agriculture Office or local Pragya Kendra (CSC).
Verification is conducted by Block Development Officers.
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers owning up to 5 acres in Jharkhand
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Jharkhand

name: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
implementing_agency: MP State Agricultural Marketing Board (Mandi Board)
benefit_summary: Price deficit financing scheme that compensates farmers when modal mandi trade prices fall below the Minimum Support Price (MSP).
benefits: Direct compensation equal to the difference between Minimum Support Price (MSP) and actual modal selling price.
Protects farmers from distress selling during post-harvest market gluts.
eligibility: Farmers registered on e-Uparjan portal selling notified agricultural oilseeds and pulses in MP mandis.
application_process: Register online on e-Uparjan MP portal prior to harvest season.
Sell produce in designated APMC mandi and obtain digital sale slip.
Price differential is automatically computed and credited via DBT.
target_beneficiaries: Oilseed and pulse growing farmers in Madhya Pradesh
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Madhya Pradesh

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojna
full_name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjmukti Yojna Maharashtra
ministry: Cooperation, Marketing and Textiles Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Provides crop loan debt relief and write-off up to Rs. 2 lakh for distressed farmer accounts.
benefits: Complete write-off/waiver of short-term crop loans up to Rs. 2,00,000.
Incentive grant up to Rs. 50,000 for farmers who repay crop loans promptly.
eligibility: Farmers in Maharashtra holding overdue short-term crop loan accounts in commercial or cooperative banks.
required_documents: Bank Passbook copy showing loan account number
application_process: Biometric authentication is conducted at CSC / Bank branch.
Loan list is verified on MahaDBT portal and settled directly with bank branch.
target_beneficiaries: Distressed agricultural borrowers in Maharashtra
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Maharashtra

name: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana
full_name: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana Chhattisgarh
ministry: Department of Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh
benefit_summary: Input incentive assistance up to Rs. 10,000 per acre for farmers cultivating paddy, maize, pulses, oilseeds, and sugarcane.
benefits: Direct input subsidy grant of Rs. 9,000 to Rs. 10,000 per acre.
Higher incentive for crop diversification away from water-intensive paddy.
eligibility: All resident farmers cultivating registered Kharif crops in Chhattisgarh.
application_process: Register on RGKNY portal via local Primary Agricultural Credit Society (PACS).
Field crop verification is conducted through e-Girdawari mobile app.
Incentive is credited in 4 quarterly installments via DBT.
target_beneficiaries: Paddy, maize, sugarcane, and pulse growers in Chhattisgarh
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Chhattisgarh

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Government of Gujarat
benefit_summary: Zero-premium state crop protection scheme providing direct financial compensation for crop losses caused by drought, excessive rain, or unseasonal rainfall.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 20,000 per hectare (up to 4 ha) for crop losses between 33% and 60%.
Financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 per hectare (up to 4 ha) for crop losses above 60%.
No premium payment required from farmers.
eligibility: All landholding farmers registered in Gujarat land revenue records (8-A / 7-12).
application_process: Apply online on e-Kutaun / i-Khedut portal when disaster is declared in notified talukas.
District Collector and revenue officers assess loss surveyed via drone/field visits.
target_beneficiaries: All landholding farmers across Gujarat
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Gujarat

name: FRUITS Portal
full_name: Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System (FRUITS)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
implementing_agency: e-Governance Department and Agriculture Department, Karnataka
benefit_summary: Unified digital portal assigning a unique FID (Farmer ID) to integrate land records, bank accounts, and agricultural subsidy delivery.
benefits: Single-window registration eliminating repeated document submission for state agricultural schemes.
Direct verification of land records (Bhoomi) for instant loan and subsidy sanctions.
eligibility: All resident farmers residing and holding agricultural land in Karnataka.
application_process: Visit fruits.karnataka.gov.in or approach local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK).
Submit land RTC and bank details to generate unique Farmer ID (FID).
target_beneficiaries: All agricultural farmers in Karnataka
funding_pattern: 100% State digital infrastructure scheme by Government of Karnataka

name: Solar Agriculture Pump Scheme
full_name: Off-Grid Solar Agriculture Pump Incentive Scheme
ministry: Energy and Petrochemicals Department, Government of Gujarat
benefit_summary: Provides up to 90% capital subsidy for installing standalone off-grid solar agriculture pumps for farm irrigation.
benefits: 90% subsidy on capital cost of 3 HP to 7.5 HP solar water pumps.
Farmer contribution restricted to 10% of system cost.
Assured daytime irrigation power without dependence on grid power.
eligibility: Farmers having agricultural land with valid water source but no grid electricity connection.
application_process: Apply online on i-Khedut portal under solar pump component.
Pay 10% beneficiary contribution after field feasibility clearance.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers without grid electricity connections requiring irrigation pumps
funding_pattern: State top-up combined with Central PM-KUSUM Component-B

name: Micro Irrigation State Subsidy
full_name: State Micro Irrigation Top-Up Scheme Bihar
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar
benefit_summary: Provides additional state top-up subsidy making drip and sprinkler irrigation systems up to 90% subsidized for small farmers.
benefits: Additional 35% state subsidy on top of Central PMKSY grant, bringing total subsidy to 90%.
Drastic reduction in water consumption and diesel pumping costs.
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Bihar cultivating fruits, vegetables, or field crops.
application_process: Register on dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in and apply under Micro-Irrigation component.
Select approved vendor for installation and field verification.
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers in Bihar
funding_pattern: State top-up grant matching PMKSY Central allocation

name: Farm Equipment & Implements Bank
full_name: Custom Hiring Centre & Farm Machinery Bank Scheme West Bengal
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal
benefit_summary: Financial support for establishing machinery hubs to rent tractors, power tillers, and reapers at low rates to small farmers.
benefits: Subsidy up to 80% for SHGs, FPOs, and cooperatives to set up Farm Machinery Banks (up to Rs. 10 lakh).
50% subsidy for individual progressive farmers purchasing high-value implements.
eligibility: Registered Farmers Groups, SHG Federations, FPOs, and individual farmers in West Bengal.
application_process: Apply online on Matir Katha portal (matirkatha.gov.in).
District Level Committee inspects site and approves equipment sanction.
target_beneficiaries: Small farmers, SHGs, and agricultural cooperatives in West Bengal
funding_pattern: 100% State Plan Scheme funded by Government of West Bengal

name: Protected Cultivation Polyhouse Scheme
full_name: Protected Cultivation and Polyhouse Construction Scheme Odisha
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Empowerment, Government of Odisha
benefit_summary: Provides 75% financial assistance for constructing naturally ventilated polyhouses, shade-net houses, and greenhouses for high-value crops.
benefits: 75% capital subsidy for erecting greenhouse and shade-net structures.
50% subsidy on high-quality planting material and drip automation.
eligibility: Farmers owning at least 500 sq. meters suitable agricultural land in Odisha.
application_process: Apply through Odisha Horticulture portal (mukhya.odisha.gov.in).
Assistant Director of Horticulture conducts site inspection before structure erection.
target_beneficiaries: Progressive horticulture farmers in Odisha
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme under State Horticulture Mission

name: Cattle & Dairy Animal Subsidy
full_name: Hi-Tech & Mini Dairy Units Scheme Haryana
ministry: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of Haryana
benefit_summary: Capital subsidy of 25% to 50% for establishing 4, 10, and 20 indigenous milch cow/buffalo dairy units.
benefits: 25% capital subsidy for General category and 50% for SC/ST category beneficiaries.
Free insurance coverage for purchased dairy animals for first 3 years.
eligibility: Resident farmers and unemployed youth in Haryana.
application_process: Apply online on Saral Haryana portal (saralharyana.gov.in).
District Veterinary Officer inspects shed and animal purchase.
target_beneficiaries: Dairy farmers and rural unemployed youth in Haryana
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Haryana

name: Seed Minikit Distribution Scheme
full_name: Certificated Seed Minikit Free Distribution Scheme Chhattisgarh
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Chhattisgarh
implementing_agency: Chhattisgarh Rajya Beej Evam Krishi Vikas Nigam
benefit_summary: Free distribution of certified high-yielding hybrid seed kits for Kharif and Rabi crops.
benefits: 100% free supply of certified seeds for paddy, pulses, and oilseeds.
Enhances seed replacement rate (SRR) and crop yield.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land in Chhattisgarh.
application_process: Distribution lists are approved by Gram Sabha / Senior Agricultural Development Officer (SADO).
Seed kits are collected directly from local PACS depots.
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers in Chhattisgarh
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Chhattisgarh

name: Magel Tyala Shettale
full_name: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Dairy Development & Fisheries, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Provides direct financial subsidy ranging from Rs. 14,433 to Rs. 75,000 to farmers in Maharashtra for excavating individual farm ponds.
benefits: Direct assistance between Rs. 14,433 and Rs. 75,000 depending on storage dimensions.
Enables on-farm rainwater harvesting and protective irrigation.
eligibility: Farmer holding minimum 0.20 ha land in Konkan or 0.40 ha in rest of Maharashtra.
required_documents: Land ownership records (7/12 extract and 8-A revenue certificate)
Self-declaration regarding non-availment of prior pond subsidy
application_process: Log in to MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in).
Select 'Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme' -> 'Individual Farm Pond'.
Submit application and participate in online lottery selection.
target_beneficiaries: Rainfed agricultural farmers across Maharashtra
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Maharashtra

name: Fal Podharopan Yojana
ministry: Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
implementing_agency: Directorate of Horticulture and Food Processing, Madhya Pradesh
benefit_summary: Provides 40% to 50% subsidy over three years to establish commercial fruit orchards.
benefits: Subsidy disbursed over three years in 60:20:20 ratio.
Covers 14 commercial fruit crops including mango, guava, orange, pomegranate, and banana.
eligibility: Permanent resident farmer of MP owning between 0.25 and 4 hectares.
application_process: Apply online via MP Horticulture portal (MPFSTS) or myScheme.
Enter land survey numbers, select fruit species, and upload documents for site clearance.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh establishing fruit orchards
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Madhya Pradesh

name: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
full_name: Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Bihar
benefit_summary: Promotes commercial fig (anjeer) cultivation by providing up to Rs. 50,000 per hectare over three years plus planting material.
benefits: Rs. 30,000/ha grant in 1st year and Rs. 10,000/ha/year in 2nd and 3rd years.
Direct supply of high-quality fig planting saplings.
eligibility: Landowning farmers in Bihar cultivating between 0.25 acres and 10 acres.
required_documents: DBT Registration Number of Bihar Agriculture Department
application_process: Log in to dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in using DBT Registration Number.
Select 'Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission: Anjeer Vikas Yojana' and submit land details.
target_beneficiaries: Landowning farmers in Bihar cultivating fig orchards
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme under Mukhyamantri Bagwani Mission

name: Agriculture Academic Studies Scheme
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of Meghalaya
implementing_agency: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Meghalaya
benefit_summary: Sponsors permanent resident science students of Meghalaya for B.Sc. Agriculture / Horticulture degree courses with monthly stipends.
benefits: Full academic sponsorship against State quota seats in recognized Agricultural Universities.
Monthly student stipend of Rs. 1,200 and annual book grant of Rs. 1,200.
eligibility: Permanent Residents of Meghalaya who passed 10+2 Science and qualified ICAR AIEEA.
application_process: Apply online on megagriculture.gov.in / megedistrict.gov.in during May-June admission notices.
Selection is done based on merit and state reservation rules.
target_beneficiaries: Science students from Meghalaya pursuing agricultural degree education
funding_pattern: 100% State Plan Scheme funded by Government of Meghalaya

name: Value Addition in Crops Scheme
full_name: Scheme to Encourage Farmers to Add Value to Crops
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Government of Gujarat
implementing_agency: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat
benefit_summary: Provides 50% subsidy up to Rs. 10 lakh for machinery and post-harvest crop processing equipment.
benefits: Financial grant equal to 50% of machine cost or up to Rs. 10,00,000.
Direct DBT transfer into beneficiary bank account.
eligibility: Active farmers who are permanent residents of Gujarat.
application_process: Apply online on ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in under Agricultural Value Addition component.
Submit physical application printout to District Agriculture Officer.
target_beneficiaries: Farmers in Gujarat undertaking post-harvest crop value addition
funding_pattern: 100% State funded scheme by Government of Gujarat
